questions.question:
Simplify the following expression:

 sqrt{(0.6859 times 0.1156 times 0.64000)/(0.289 times 0.1600 times 0.54872)} (Correct your answer up to three decimal places)
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Equate **decimal places**: Total numerator places = 13, Total denominator places = 12, resulting in a factor of 10−¹. Identify **powers**: 6859 = 19³, 54872 = 38³ = (2 × 19)³, and 1156 = 34² = (2 × 17)². Simplify the ratios: (19/38)³ × (34/17)² × (64000/1600) × 0.1 = (1/8) × 4 × 40 × 0.1 = 2. Calculate the final root: √2 ≈ 1.414. **∴ The correct answer is 1.414.**

questions.question: Two positive numbers differ by 20. The mean proportional between these two numbers is 24. What is the sum of these two numbers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **difference** (x − y) = 20 and **mean proportional** √xy = 24.

Square of mean proportional: xy = 24² = 576.

Using the identity: (x + y)² = (x − y)² + 4xy

⇒ (x + y)² = 20² + 4 × 576 = 400 + 2304 = 2704.

⇒ **Sum** (x + y) = √2704 = 52.

**∴ The correct answer is 52.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Let the two **positive numbers** be 'a' and 'b' (where a > b).

**Given:**

Difference between numbers (a − b) = 20

Mean proportional between a and b = 24

**Formula Used:**

1) **Mean Proportional** = √(a × b)

2) (a + b)² = (a − b)² + 4ab

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7bdfe76fe15d0d394ddd8c3803828c159c3e19e9a3eac7f08c03017f1a8d1d5.png] 

⇒ From **mean proportional** definition: √ab = 24

⇒ Squaring both sides: ab = 24 × 24 = 576

⇒ We know that (a + b)² = (a − b)² + 4ab

⇒ (a + b)² = (20)² + 4 × 576

⇒ (a + b)² = 400 + 2304

⇒ (a + b)² = 2704

⇒ a + b = √2704

⇒ a + b = 52

**∴ The correct answer is 52.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is the square root of their product, expressed as x = √ab.

Third Proportional

If a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a:b = b:c), then c is called the third proportional, where c = b² ÷ a.

Algebraic Relationship

The relationship between the sum and difference of two numbers is given by the identity (a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab.

questions.question: Workers P and Q can complete a task in 16 days if working together. P alone takes 24 days. If P and Q start the task together, but Q leaves after 4 days, how many more days will P alone take to finish the work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Combined efficiency of **P and Q** = 1/16, and efficiency of **P** alone = 1/24.

**Work done** by **P and Q** together in **4 days** = 4 ÷ 16 = 1/4 of total work.

**Remaining work** to be finished by **P** alone = 1 − 1/4 = 3/4.

**More days** required by **P** = (3/4) × 24 = **18 days**.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

questions.question: In a school, Class A has 24 students with an average height of 160 cm, and Class B has 20 students with an average height of 168 cm. The average height of students in Class C is 165 cm. If the overall average height of all students from Classes A, B and C is 164 cm, find the number of students in Class C.
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Net deviation from the overall **Average Height** (164 cm) must be zero. Deviation for **Class A** = (160 − 164) × 24 = −96 Deviation for **Class B** = (168 − 164) × 20 = +80 Total deviation (A + B) = −16. To balance, **Class C** must provide a deviation of +16. Deviation per student in **Class C** = 165 − 164 = +1. Number of students in **Class C** = 16 ÷ 1 = 16. **∴ The correct answer is 16.**

questions.question: A borrower takes a loan of ₹1,860 at a simple interest rate of 12% per annum. After some years, the total amount payable becomes ₹2,529.60. For how many years was the loan taken?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Calculate total interest percentage: **Interest** = 2529.60 − 1860 = 669.60

Total Interest % = (669.60 / 1860) × 100 = 36%

Since the rate is 12% per year, **Time (T)** = Total % / Rate per annum

**T** = 36% / 12% = 3 years

**∴ The correct answer is 3 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹1,860

**Amount (A)** = ₹2,529.60

**Rate (R)** = 12% p.a.

**Formula Used:** Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f6dfeb8fd9dd17148cc101050a8d4c6ba05021b39a1833850dd6485eff97fa9.png] 

⇒ **Simple Interest (SI)** = Amount − Principal

⇒ SI = 2529.60 − 1860 = 669.60

⇒ 669.60 = (1860 × 12 × T) / 100

⇒ 669.60 = 18.6 × 12 × T

⇒ 669.60 = 223.2 × T

⇒ T = 669.60 / 223.2

⇒ T = 3 years

**∴ The correct answer is 3 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

The basic formula is SI = (P × R × T) / 100, where P is **Principal**, R is **Rate**, and T is **Time**.

Amount Calculation

Total Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI). It can also be expressed as A = P(1 + RT/100).

Finding Rate of Interest

If time and interest are known, the rate can be calculated as R = (SI × 100) / (P × T).

questions.question: Kavita's monthly salary increased by 25%, and then decreased by 20%. If her initial salary is ₹58,000, what was her final salary?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the **Successive Percentage Change** formula: Net % change = x + y + (xy/100).

Here, x = +25% (increase) and y = −20% (decrease).

Net change = 25 − 20 + [25 × (−20) / 100] = 5 − 5 = 0%.

Since the **net change is 0%**, the final salary remains the same as the initial salary.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹58,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Initial Salary** = ₹58,000

**First Change** = 25% Increase

**Second Change** = 20% Decrease

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b316dacedaf14efbc55ba2b85483b98883215c5b04096e9262187ef8ed375712.png] 

**Step 1: Calculate salary after 25% increase**

⇒ Salary after increase = 58,000 + (25/100 × 58,000)

⇒ Salary after increase = 58,000 + 14,500 = ₹72,500

**Step 2: Calculate salary after 20% decrease on the new amount**

⇒ Final Salary = 72,500 − (20/100 × 72,500)

⇒ Final Salary = 72,500 − 14,500

⇒ Final Salary = ₹58,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹58,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Formula

When a value is changed by x% and then by y%, the effective change is (x + y + xy/100)%. Use positive for **increase** and negative for **decrease**.

Multiplier Method

Final Value = Initial Value × (1 ± r₁/100) × (1 ± r₂/100). In this case: 58,000 × 1.25 × 0.80 = 58,000 × 1 = 58,000.

Base Change Property

An increase of 25% (1/4) followed by a decrease of 20% (1/5) results in no change because (5/4) × (4/5) = 1.

questions.question: The total surface area of a cube having side 94 cm is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **Total Surface Area (TSA)** of a cube follows the formula 6 × a².

Since the side is **94 cm**, the unit digit of 94² is **6** (4 × 4 = 16).

Multiplying by 6, the final unit digit must be **6** (6 × 6 = 36).

Estimating: 94² is slightly less than 100² (10,000), so TSA is slightly less than 60,000.

Calculation: 6 × 8836 = 53016.

**∴ The correct answer is 53,016 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The **side length (a)** of the **cube** is 94 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of a cube = 6 × (side)²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14367d1a5060416fa920653c183c30f1e4dfa3c9bef614ddc9490f1bb5525ca2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ TSA = 6 × (94)²

⇒ TSA = 6 × (94 × 94)

⇒ 94² = (100 − 6)² = 10000 − 1200 + 36 = 8836

⇒ TSA = 6 × 8836

⇒ TSA = 53016 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 53,016 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cube

The **volume** represents the total capacity of the cube and is calculated as **a³**.

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

The **LSA** refers to the area of only the four side faces (excluding top and bottom), given by **4 × a²**.

Body Diagonal of a Cube

The length of the **longest rod** that can be placed inside a cube is **a√3**.

Face Diagonal of a Cube

The diagonal of any single **square face** of the cube is calculated as **a√2**.

questions.question: A and B can do a piece of work in 12 days and 30 days, respectively. Both work for 2 days and then A leaves. How long (in days) will B take to complete the remaining work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = **LCM**(12, 30) = 60 units.

**Efficiency** of **A** = 5 units/day, **B** = 2 units/day.

Work done by both in **2 days** = (5 + 2) × 2 = 14 units.

**Remaining work** = 60 − 14 = 46 units.

Time taken by **B** alone = 46 ÷ 2 = 23 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 23 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **A** completes work in **12 days** and **B** in **30 days**.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 **A**
 12
 60
 5
 
 

 **B**
 30
 2
 
 

⇒ **Total work** (LCM of 12 and 30) = 60 units.

⇒ Work completed by **A** and **B** together in **2 days** = (5 + 2) × 2 = 14 units.

⇒ **Remaining work** to be done by **B** = 60 − 14 = 46 units.

⇒ **Time taken by B** to complete the remaining work = Remaining Work ÷ Efficiency of B

⇒ Time = 46 ÷ 2 = 23 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 23 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relationship between Efficiency and Time

**Efficiency** is inversely proportional to **Time**. If time ratio is x : y, the efficiency ratio is y : x.

Work & Wages

Wages are generally distributed in the ratio of the **work done** by each person, which is the product of **Efficiency** × **Time**.

Total Work Calculation

Total work can be assumed as any multiple of the given days, but **LCM** is preferred to keep efficiencies in whole numbers.

questions.question: A company hires a certain number of temporary workers for a project. If each worker is paid ₹500 per day, the total daily wage bill exceeds the company’s budget by ₹4,000. If instead each worker is paid ₹450 per day, the total daily wage bill falls short of the budget by ₹2,000. Find the number of workers hired.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total difference in the **daily wage bill** = Excess + Shortfall = 4000 + 2000 = ₹6000.

Difference in **daily pay** per worker = 500 − 450 = ₹50.

Total **temporary workers** = Total Difference ÷ Difference per Worker = 6000 ÷ 50 = 120.

**∴ The correct answer is 120.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Pay Rate₁ = ₹500, Pay Rate₂ = ₹450, Budget Excess = ₹4,000, Budget Shortfall = ₹2,000.

**Formula Used:** Total Wage Bill = Number of Workers × Daily Pay Rate

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ede528680085e770f8b96003c783aa94a4cd83bf6f46375fe0655df4d61e931a.png] 

⇒ Let **n** be the number of workers and **B** be the company’s budget.

⇒ Case 1: 500 × n = B + 4000

⇒ Case 2: 450 × n = B − 2000

⇒ Subtracting Case 2 from Case 1: (500n − 450n) = (B + 4000) − (B − 2000)

⇒ 50n = 4000 + 2000

⇒ 50n = 6000

⇒ n = 6000 ÷ 50 = 120.

**∴ The correct answer is 120.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Excess and Deficit Rule

When comparing two scenarios where one results in an excess (E) and the other in a shortfall or deficit (D), the total difference between the two conditions is calculated as (E + D).

Linear Equations in One Variable

These problems follow the standard form ax + b = c, where x represents the unknown quantity (like the number of workers) and can be solved by isolating the variable.

Rate-Quantity Relationship

The change in total value is equal to the quantity multiplied by the change in rate: ΔTotal = Quantity × ΔRate.

questions.question: Find the third proportional to 8 and 16.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **Third Proportional** of two numbers **a** and **b** is given by the formula **b² ÷ a**.

⇒ Third Proportional = (16 × 16) ÷ 8

⇒ 256 ÷ 8 = 32

**∴ The correct answer is 32.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First number (a) = 8

Second number (b) = 16

**Formula Used:**

If three numbers **a, b, and c** are in **continued proportion**, then:

a : b :: b : c

⇒ a ÷ b = b ÷ c

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f58f9c14750126567a1f527e804ae872007fcc5ed4d629983bb6e218e8b72b5f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **third proportional** be **x**.

⇒ 8 : 16 :: 16 : x

⇒ 8 ÷ 16 = 16 ÷ x

⇒ 1 ÷ 2 = 16 ÷ x

⇒ x = 16 × 2

⇒ x = 32

**∴ The correct answer is 32.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The **Mean Proportional** between two numbers **a** and **b** is calculated as **√(a × b)**.

Fourth Proportional

For three numbers **a, b, and c**, the **fourth proportional** (x) satisfies **a : b = c : x**, which means **x = (b × c) ÷ a**.

Continued Proportion

Three quantities are in **continued proportion** if the ratio of the first to the second is equal to the ratio of the second to the third.

questions.question: A number leaves a remainder of 2 when divided by 5 and a remainder of 3 when divided by 7. What is the smallest positive integer that satisfies both conditions?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

List integers that leave **remainder 2** when divided by 5: 2, 7, 12, **17**, 22, ...

List integers that leave **remainder 3** when divided by 7: 3, 10, **17**, 24, ...

Identify the first **common number** that appears in both sequences.

The **smallest positive integer** satisfying both conditions is 17.

**∴ The correct answer is 17.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number (N) ÷ 5 → Remainder = 2

Number (N) ÷ 7 → Remainder = 3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5b2f07e6d9bc25f90755808d7108d57073ca896a7d3bdf21e78932dd5e06eb5.png] 

Step-by-step Calculation:

⇒ Let N = 5k + 2 and N = 7m + 3

⇒ 5k + 2 = 7m + 3

⇒ 5k = 7m + 1

⇒ If m = 1, 5k = 8 (Not an integer)

⇒ If m = 2, 5k = 7(2) + 1 = 15

⇒ k = 15 ÷ 5 = 3

⇒ Smallest N = 5(3) + 2 = 17

**∴ The correct answer is 17.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chinese Remainder Theorem (CRT)

CRT provides a systematic way to solve systems of **linear congruences** with pairwise **coprime moduli** like 5 and 7.

General Form of Solution

The general solution for such problems is **N = (LCM(d₁, d₂) × n) + x**, where x is the smallest positive integer and n = 0, 1, 2...

Successive Division Method

For larger numbers, use **N = d₁k + r₁** and substitute into the second congruence to solve for k iteratively.

questions.question: Two complementary angles are such that twice the measure of one angle is equal to three times the measure of the other. The measure of the larger angle is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of the two **complementary angles** is 3 : 2 (since 2 × **Angle₁** = 3 × **Angle₂**).

Total units = 3 + 2 = 5 units.

Given, total sum = 90º (complementary property).

5 units = 90º ⇒ 1 unit = 18º.

**Larger angle** = 3 units = 3 × 18º = 54º.

**∴ The correct answer is 54º.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of two angles = 90º

Relationship: 2 × (One angle) = 3 × (Other angle)

**Formula Used:**

For **Complementary Angles**, θ₁ + θ₂ = 90º.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a34f520b1a3519db79c3b0909f35dc2ad88eb338be144bb517ac23cd4262c69e.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the two angles be **x** and **y**.

⇒ x + y = 90º ---(i)

⇒ 2x = 3y ---(ii)

⇒ x = 3y / 2

Substituting the value of x in equation (i):

⇒ (3y / 2) + y = 90º

⇒ (3y + 2y) / 2 = 90º

⇒ 5y / 2 = 90º

⇒ 5y = 180º

⇒ y = 36º

Now, finding the value of x:

⇒ x = 90º − 36º

⇒ x = 54º

Comparing 54º and 36º, the **larger angle** is 54º.

**∴ The correct answer is 54º.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Complementary Angles

Two angles are called complementary if their sum is exactly 90º. Each angle is the complement of the other.

Supplementary Angles

Two angles are called supplementary if their sum is exactly 180º. They form a linear pair when placed adjacently on a straight line.

Adjacent Angles

Angles that have a common vertex and a common side but do not overlap are known as adjacent angles.

questions.question: The LCM of the numbers 5, 8.3 and 0.19 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert **decimals** into their **simplest fractions**: 5 = 5/1, 8.3 = 83/10, and 0.19 = 19/100.

Formula: **LCM** of fractions = LCM of Numerators ÷ HCF of Denominators.

LCM(5, 83, 19) = 5 × 83 × 19 = 7885 (since all are co-prime).

HCF(1, 10, 100) = 1.

Result = 7885 ÷ 1 = 7885.

**∴ The correct answer is 7885.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers are 5, 8.3, and 0.19.

**Formula Used:** To find the **LCM** of decimals, equalize the number of decimal places and find the LCM of the resulting integers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d505d26da601793e7cfc7c4bbe0bb2894fbd8865997811136acb6462e05e46a3.png] 

⇒ Step 1: Make decimal places equal: 5.00, 8.30, 0.19.

⇒ Step 2: Treat them as **integers**: 500, 830, and 19.

⇒ Step 3: Find **prime factors**:

⇒ 500 = 2² × 5³

⇒ 830 = 2 × 5 × 83

⇒ 19 = 19 (Prime)

⇒ Step 4: LCM = Highest powers of all prime factors = 2² × 5³ × 83 × 19.

⇒ LCM = 4 × 125 × 83 × 19 = 500 × 1577 = 788500.

⇒ Step 5: Adjust decimal: 788500 ÷ 100 = 7885.

**∴ The correct answer is 7885.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM of Fractions

The **Least Common Multiple (LCM)** of a set of fractions is given by: (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators).

HCF of Fractions

The **Highest Common Factor (HCF)** of a set of fractions is given by: (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators).

Co-prime Numbers

Numbers that have only 1 as a **common factor** are co-prime. The LCM of co-prime numbers is always equal to their **product**.

questions.question: Raghav drives from City A to City B in three equal segments of 40 km each. He drives the first segment at 40 km/hr, the second at 60 km/hr, and the third at 120 km/hr. What is his average speed for the whole trip?
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ When an object covers **equal distances** at different speeds, the **Average Speed** is the **Harmonic Mean** of the speeds. Average Speed = 3 ÷ (1/v₁ + 1/v₂ + 1/v₃) ⇒ Average Speed = 3 ÷ (1/40 + 1/60 + 1/120) ⇒ Average Speed = 3 ÷ (6/120) = 3 × 20 = 60 km/hr. **∴ The correct answer is 60 km/hr.**

questions.question: During a sale, 50% of the goods are sold at 36% profit, 40% of the remaining goods are sold at 14% profit and the still remaining goods are sold at a loss of 21%. If there is an overall profit of x%, then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the **Weighted Average** method for calculation.

Ratio of goods quantity = 50% : (40% of 50%) : (Remaining 30%) = 50 : 20 : 30 = 5 : 2 : 3

Overall Profit x% = (5 × 36 + 2 × 14 + 3 × (−21)) ÷ (5 + 2 + 3)

x = (180 + 28 − 63) ÷ 10 = 145 ÷ 10 = 14.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 14.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png]

questions.question: If the average of three numbers is 7, what is their total sum?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **Total Sum** is simply the product of the **Average** and the **Total count** of numbers.

Total Sum = Average × Number of items

Total Sum = 7 × 3 = 21

**∴ The correct answer is 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of **three numbers** = 7

Number of quantities (n) = 3

**Formula Used:**

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ee313461ea566af4e97fc2186767785b7c8703b5b6cf716313d63761ecd8e92.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 7 = (Sum of three numbers) ÷ 3

⇒ Sum of three numbers = 7 × 3

⇒ Sum of three numbers = 21

**∴ The correct answer is 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

The most common type of average, calculated by adding all numbers in a set and dividing by the count of numbers.

Weighted Average

Used when different values have different levels of importance or frequency: (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂) ÷ (w₁ + w₂).

Average of Consecutive Numbers

For a series in Arithmetic Progression (AP), the average is simply (First Term + Last Term) ÷ 2.

questions.question: The sum of two positive numbers is 27 and their product is 176. The positive difference between them is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the **algebraic identity**: (Difference)² = (Sum)² − 4 × (Product)

⇒ (Difference)² = 27² − 4 × 176

⇒ (Difference)² = 729 − 704 = 25

⇒ Difference = √25 = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Sum** of two numbers = 27, **Product** = 176.

**Formula Used:** Factorisation method to find the numbers x and y such that x + y = 27 and xy = 176.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16b030bd314ae889ae82f859a59efcaae1661b5d39af371fd29afd29c95bf6f1.png] 

⇒ Let the two **positive numbers** be x and y.

⇒ x + y = 27 and x × y = 176.

⇒ Factorizing 176 to find pairs whose sum is 27: 176 = 1 × 176, 2 × 88, 4 × 44, 8 × 22, 11 × 16.

⇒ Since 11 + 16 = 27, the numbers are 16 and 11.

⇒ Positive difference = 16 − 11 = 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Relationship

The core relationship between sum, product, and difference is given by (x + y)² − (x − y)² = 4xy.

Quadratic Equation Formulation

If sum (S) and product (P) of two numbers are known, the numbers are the roots of the quadratic equation t² − St + P = 0.

Nature of Roots

For the difference to be a **rational number**, the value (Sum² − 4 × Product) must be a perfect square.

questions.question: A, B and C start a business. A invests ₹1,21,500 for 12 months, B invests ₹1,02,060 for 9 months and C invests ₹97,200, but withdrew ₹24,500 after 6 months. If the total profit earned at the end of the year is ₹1,69,797, find the difference between the profit share of A and the profit share of B.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective capital ratio (Investment × Time):

A : B : C = (1,21,500 × 12) : (1,02,060 × 9) : (97,200 × 6 + 72,700 × 6)

A : B : C = 14,58,000 : 9,18,540 : 10,19,400 = 24,300 : 15,309 : 16,990

Sum of ratio parts = 24,300 + 15,309 + 16,990 = 56,599 units

Total profit = ₹1,69,797 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹3

Difference (A − B) = (24,300 − 15,309) × 3 = 8,991 × 3 = ₹26,973.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹26,973.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Investment of **A** = ₹1,21,500 for 12 months

Investment of **B** = ₹1,02,060 for 9 months

Investment of **C** = ₹97,200 for 6 months and (₹97,200 − ₹24,500) = ₹72,700 for 6 months

Total Profit = **₹1,69,797**

**Formula:** Profit Share Ratio = (Investment₁ × Time₁) : (Investment₂ × Time₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65801e50aca47b02712305241449b01c39a955865b2153ba4ef17ddb32555b68.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Equivalent Capital of **A** = 1,21,500 × 12 = 14,58,000

⇒ Equivalent Capital of **B** = 1,02,060 × 9 = 9,18,540

⇒ Equivalent Capital of **C** = (97,200 × 6) + (72,700 × 6) = 5,83,200 + 4,36,200 = 10,19,400

⇒ Ratio **A : B : C** = 14,58,000 : 9,18,540 : 10,19,400

⇒ Dividing by common factor 60: 24,300 : 15,309 : 16,990

⇒ Sum of ratios = 24,300 + 15,309 + 16,990 = 56,599

⇒ Total Profit = ₹1,69,797

⇒ Value of 1 unit = 1,69,797 ÷ 56,599 = ₹3

⇒ Difference between share of **A** and **B** = (24,300 − 15,309) units

⇒ Difference = 8,991 × 3 = ₹26,973

**∴ The correct answer is ₹26,973.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Partnership Law

Profit is always distributed in the ratio of the product of Capital (C) and Time (T), i.e., P₁ : P₂ = C₁×T₁ : C₂×T₂.

Effective Capital for Multiple Transactions

When a partner changes investment mid-term, effective capital = (C₁×T₁ + C₂×T₂ + ...), where T is the duration for each capital amount.

Calculating Unknown Shares

Individual Profit = (Individual Ratio Part ÷ Total Ratio Sum) × Total Profit.

questions.question: A sum, when invested at 20% simple interest per annum, amounts to ₹5,280 after 3 years. What is the simple interest (in ₹) on the same sum at the same rate in 2 years?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total **Simple Interest** for 3 years = 20% × 3 = 60%.

Total **Amount** = 100% (Principal) + 60% (Interest) = 160% = ₹5,280.

**Simple Interest** for 2 years = 20% × 2 = 40%.

Required **SI** = (5,280 ÷ 160%) × 40% = 5,280 ÷ 4 = ₹1,320.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,320.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Amount (A)** = ₹5,280, **Rate (R)** = 20% p.a., **Time (T₁)** = 3 years.

**Formula Used:**

**Simple Interest (SI)** = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Amount (A)** = Principal (P) + SI = P × (1 + (R × T) ÷ 100)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1a8bedb2ea852ae4844f90f805d82f70601ad0d4574750bcfc9a897950697a7.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 5,280 = P × (1 + (20 × 3) ÷ 100)

⇒ 5,280 = P × (1 + 0.6)

⇒ 5,280 = 1.6P

⇒ **Principal (P)** = 5,280 ÷ 1.6 = ₹3,300

⇒ **Simple Interest** for 2 years (T₂ = 2) = (3,300 × 20 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ **SI** = 33 × 40 = ₹1,320

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,320.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Properties

In **Simple Interest**, the interest remains constant for every year as it is always calculated on the original **Principal** amount.

Principal Formula

The **Principal** can be calculated if the Amount, Rate, and Time are known: P = (A × 100) ÷ (100 + RT).

SI vs CI

For the first year (if compounded annually), **Simple Interest** and **Compound Interest** are equal for the same principal and rate.

questions.question: What is the largest 6-digit number that is completely divisible by 96?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **largest 6-digit number** is 999999.

Divide 999999 by **96** to find the **remainder**.

999999 ÷ 96 gives a remainder of **63**.

Subtract this remainder from 999999 to get the largest divisible number.

999999 − 63 = 999936.

**∴ The correct answer is 999936.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Divisor = 96, Largest 6-digit number = 999999.

**Formula:** Required Number = (Largest n-digit number) − (Remainder when largest n-digit number is divided by divisor).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba979b630fdebfa17f6e4cbd9199d6394be1f57272313ea48ab2748854092744.png] 

⇒ **Largest 6-digit number** = 999999

⇒ Dividing 999999 by 96:

⇒ 999999 = 10416 × 96 + 63

⇒ **Remainder** = 63

⇒ Required number = 999999 − 63

⇒ Required number = 999936

**∴ The correct answer is 999936.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule for 96

A number is divisible by **96** if it is divisible by both **3** (sum of digits) and **32** (last 5 digits divisible by 32).

Smallest n-digit number divisible by x

Required number = **Smallest n-digit number** + (x − remainder), where remainder is obtained by dividing the smallest n-digit number by x.

Division Algorithm

Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder. For perfect divisibility, the **remainder** must be zero.

questions.question: The price of fuel decreases by 45%, 25% and 15% in three successive months, but increases by 45% in the fourth month. What is the percentage decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price? (Round off to 2 decimal places.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume the **initial price** of fuel is 100.

Final Price = 100 × (0.55) × (0.75) × (0.85) × (1.45)

Final Price = 100 × 0.50840625 = 50.840625

Net **percentage decrease** = 100 − 50.840625 = 49.159375%

Rounding to 2 decimal places, we get 49.16%.

**∴ The correct answer is 49.16%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial changes: 45% decrease, 25% decrease, 15% decrease.

Fourth month change: 45% increase.

**Formula Used:**

Final Value = Initial Value × (1 − r₁/100) × (1 − r₂/100) × (1 − r₃/100) × (1 + r₄/100)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdc518e662bb7907779d1052263157db25d5bb4bd0304070bce35474fa1c6523.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let **Initial Price** = 100

⇒ Price after 1st month = 100 − 45% of 100 = 55

⇒ Price after 2nd month = 55 − 25% of 55 = 55 − 13.75 = 41.25

⇒ Price after 3rd month = 41.25 − 15% of 41.25 = 41.25 − 6.1875 = 35.0625

⇒ Price after 4th month = 35.0625 + 45% of 35.0625 = 35.0625 + 15.778125 = 50.840625

⇒ Net **Percentage Decrease** = 100 − 50.840625 = 49.159375%

⇒ Rounding to two decimal places = 49.16%

**∴ The correct answer is 49.16%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

For two successive changes of a% and b%, the net change is given by (a + b + ab/100)%. Use negative values for decrease.

Multiplying Factor Concept

To find the final value after an x% change, multiply the base by (1 ± x/100). For multiple changes, multiply all factors sequentially.

Rounding Rules

When rounding to 2 decimal places, if the third decimal digit is 5 or greater, round up the second digit.

questions.question: A shopkeeper fixes the marked price of an item 120% above its cost price. What percentage of discount on marked price should be allowed to gain 43%?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **Cost Price (CP)** = 100.

**Marked Price (MP)** = 100 + 120 = 220.

To **gain** 43%, **Selling Price (SP)** must be 143.

**Discount** needed = MP − SP = 220 − 143 = 77.

**Discount %** = (77 ÷ 220) × 100 = 35%.

**∴ The correct answer is 35%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png]

questions.question: A wholesaler offers a trade discount of 30% on the marked price of an electric kettle to retailers. A retailer then announces a scheme discount of 12% on the price after receiving the trade discount. If the retailer sells the kettle to a customer for ₹2,464, what is the marked price of the kettle?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The effective price after successive discounts is: **MP** × 70% × 88% = **SP**.

**MP** × 0.7 × 0.88 = ₹2,464

**MP** × 0.616 = ₹2,464

**MP** = 2,464 ÷ 0.616 = ₹4,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Trade Discount** = 30%

**Scheme Discount** = 12%

**Selling Price (SP)** = ₹2,464

**Formula Used:**

**Final SP = MP × (100 − d₁)/100 × (100 − d₂)/100**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdfa23b8e2bcaa95e0881315bf18cab79b84074c76bdf041232a6f83ee1b39ce.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **Marked Price (MP)** of the electric kettle be M.

⇒ Price after 30% **trade discount** = M × (100 − 30) ÷ 100 = 0.70M.

⇒ Final **Selling Price** after 12% **scheme discount** = 0.70M × (100 − 12) ÷ 100.

⇒ 2,464 = 0.70M × 0.88

⇒ 2,464 = 0.616 × M

⇒ M = 2,464 ÷ 0.616

⇒ M = 4,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Single Equivalent Discount

For two successive discounts of a% and b%, the single equivalent discount is [a + b − (a × b)/100]%.

Relation between MP and CP

The ratio between **Marked Price** and **Cost Price** is given by: MP/CP = (100 + Profit%)/(100 − Discount%).

Basis of Discount

A **discount** (whether trade or scheme) is always calculated on the current **Marked Price** or the preceding balance price in a chain.

questions.question: Evaluate sqrt{36} + sqrt{(324)/(81)} + sqrt{(9.5 times 0.0085 times 18.9)/(0.021 times 0.0017 times 1.9)} .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Break the expression into three parts: **Part 1** is √36 = 6.

**Part 2** is √(324 ÷ 81) = √4 = 2.

**Part 3**: Count decimal places. Top has 6, Bottom has 8. Net adjustment is 10² in the numerator.

Simplify: √[(95 ÷ 19) × (85 ÷ 17) × (189 ÷ 21) × 100] = √(5 × 5 × 9 × 100) = 150.

Total Sum = 6 + 2 + 150 = 158.

**∴ The correct answer is 158.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given Expression:** √36 + √(324 ÷ 81) + √((9.5 × 0.0085 × 18.9) ÷ (0.021 × 0.0017 × 1.9))

The expression involves **square roots** and **decimal simplification**. We solve each term step-by-step:

⇒ Term 1: √36 = 6

⇒ Term 2: √(324 ÷ 81) = √4 = 2

⇒ Term 3: To simplify √((9.5 × 0.0085 × 18.9) ÷ (0.021 × 0.0017 × 1.9)), remove decimals by multiplying both numerator and denominator by 10⁸.

⇒ √((95 × 85 × 189 × 100) ÷ (21 × 17 × 19))

⇒ √((95 ÷ 19) × (85 ÷ 17) × (189 ÷ 21) × 100)

⇒ √(5 × 5 × 9 × 100)

⇒ √(22500) = 150

Now, add all the **simplified values** obtained from the steps above:

⇒ 6 + 2 + 150 = 158

**∴ The correct answer is 158.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

Always prioritize **Orders** (roots and exponents) before addition and subtraction to ensure correct **arithmetic evaluation**.

Decimal Shift in Fractions

When dividing decimals, shift the decimal point to the right in both the numerator and denominator by the same number of places to simplify into **whole numbers**.

Square Root of Products

The property √(a × b × c) = √a × √b × √c allows for the **factorization** of large numbers under a root for easier calculation.

questions.question: A man was seven times older than his son five years ago and is now four times older. What is the son’s present age?
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Ratio 5 years ago (M:S) = 7 : 1 (Difference = 6 units) Current Ratio (M:S) = 4 : 1 (Difference = 3 units) Equalize differences by multiplying current ratio by 2 → 8 : 2 Change in **son's age** units from 5 years ago to now = 2 − 1 = 1 unit → 5 years **Son's present age** = 2 units = 2 × 5 = 10 years. **∴ The correct answer is 10 years.**

questions.question: P sells an item to Q at 25% profit. Q sells the same item to R at 60% loss. If R paid ₹5,166 for the item, then at what price (in ₹) is the item purchased by P?
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Ratio of **Cost Price (CP)** for **P** to **Q** = 100 : 125 = 4 : 5 Ratio of **CP** for **Q** to **R** = 100 : 40 = 5 : 2 Combined ratio **P : Q : R** = 4 : 5 : 2 Given **R** paid 2 units = ₹5,166 1 unit = ₹2,583 ⇒ **P** purchased for 4 units = 4 × 2,583 = ₹10,332 **∴ The correct answer is ₹10,332.**

questions.question: From the top of a building 100√3 meters high, the angle of depression to a bicycle on the ground is 30°. What is the horizontal distance (in meters) from the building to the bicycle?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a standard **30°−60°−90°** right-angled triangle, the ratio of sides opposite to the angles is **1 : √3 : 2**.

The side opposite to **30°** (building height) corresponds to **1 unit** = **100√3 m**.

The side opposite to **60°** (horizontal distance) corresponds to **√3 units**.

⇒ Horizontal distance = **100√3 × √3** = **300 m**.

∴ The correct answer is 300 m.<
